title: Valuation Refresh, Tolerance and Class Movement Figures by Class
content:
Four figures govern how often a Keyturn Vehicle Listing is valued again, how far a host's own declared value may sit from the marketplace's, how long a value class review takes and how many settled trips a listing needs before it may move up a class.

| Class | Refresh interval (calendar days) | Tolerance on a declared value (per cent) | Value class review (business days) | Settled trips needed before moving up a class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Keyturn Economy Class Listing | 365 | 15 | 3 | 5 |
| Keyturn Standard Class Listing | 365 | 12 | 3 | 5 |
| Keyturn Premium Class Listing | 270 | 10 | 2 | 10 |
| Keyturn Luxury Class Listing | 180 | 8 | 2 | 15 |
| Keyturn Exotic Class Listing | 120 | 5 | 5 | 25 |
| Keyturn Commercial Van Class Listing | 270 | 12 | 4 | 10 |

The refresh interval is counted in whole calendar days from the date of the last valuation; the review period is counted in business days. The trip figure is a count of settled trips, and it is the figure of the class the listing would move up into, not the figure of the class it is leaving.
